title: Simple Photo Background Remover
description:
Small online shops photograph their own products, often on a table with a light background. Marketplaces and shop themes expect clean cut-outs: transparent PNGs or products on pure white. Editing every photo by hand takes several minutes per image. The goal is an easy-to-use tool that removes the background from a whole folder of product photos automatically.

Requirements

  • Process a folder of JPG/PNG photos in one run.
  • Output transparent PNGs, or JPGs on a pure white background.
  • Run on a normal laptop without a GPU or paid service.
  • Keep the original resolution and file names.

Challenges

  • Products with colors close to the background, light labels and reflections.
  • Shadows and uneven light on the background.
  • Fine details such as cables, fur or transparent parts.
goals:
• At least 9 of 10 studio-style product photos need no manual touch-up.
  • Processing time below 2 seconds per photo on a laptop CPU.
  • Failed cut-outs are easy to spot from the tool's output (foreground share per image).
